GHA.note: The directive requires the card for transactions; no authentication service is stated.
No count or share is given.
The directive covers licensed financial institutions, not a public register keyed on the number.

facts.fact: The Bank of Ghana directs that from 1 July 2022 the Ghana Card is the only identification card for transactions at all Bank of Ghana licensed and regulated financial institutions, under Regulation 7 of L.I. 2111.
